race.comment: DURHAM (3) got the job done narrowly as the favourite at Murray Bridge in his penultimate start, and then was not far off the placings in a far tougher field at Ballarat just over 5 weeks ago, when dropped back to a mile. The return to a middle distance is the key here, and with the aid of a 3kg claim, he goes on top for us. SOMEWHERE SOON (5) was a victim of circumstance 2 starts back, and was much more like it last time out when finishing runner-up as the favourite 3 weeks ago. She will need some luck from a wide gate here, but she is good enough to figure in the finish. KAZARU (4) has only been fair in 2 starts this prep in Victoria, but when the Stokes stable cross back to this State, they normally get results. This mare will be peaking third up, and a form reversal would be no shock. TOTTORI (2) is a top 4 chance.
